headlines.name: Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.draw_semantics
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (d : ℕ) (hd : 14 ≤ d) (R : Fin (m + 1) → ℕ) (P : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, R i = ∑ j, P j),
  m + 1 ≤ d →
    n + 1 ≤ d →
      m * n ≤ d - 1 →
        (∀ (i : Fin (m + 1)), (n + 1) * (3 * d) ≤ R i) →
          (∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)), (m + 1) * (3 * d) ≤ P j) →
            ∀ (h : ℕ),
              (∀ (bits : Fin (Math115.DenseLatticeCompletion.completionBits d R P h) → Bool),
                  Math115.CompletionSamplerProgram.draw
                      (Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.parameters d R P h, List.ofFn bits) =
                    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
                      ↑(Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.programTable d hd R P htotal h bits)) ∧
                OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
                    (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                      (Math115.CompletionSamplerSemantics.programTable d hd R P htotal h))
                    (Math115.LatticeCompletionAccuracy.originalUniform R P
                      (OAI.ContingencyTables.GreedyFeasibleTable.table R P htotal)) ≤
                  Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSampler.draw_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h : ℕ)
  (bits :
    Fin
        (Math115.PhysicalReferenceBoolean.outerBits r
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.walkCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.restartCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.stepPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.terminalPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            h)) →
      Bool),
  Math115.LatticeSampler.draw (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑(Math115.PhysicalBooleanSampler.draw r c htotal
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.walkCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.restartCount (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.stepPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.dimensionAllowance
            (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalMassBase r) h)
          (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.terminalPrecision (Math115.CompletionOuterSchedule.physicalSmallCount r c) h)
          bits)

headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSampler.draw_spec
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h : ℕ),
  have q := Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h);
  ∃ f,
    (∀ (bits : Fin q → Bool),
        Math115.LatticeSampler.draw (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits) =
          OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑(f bits)) ∧
      ↑(OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation
            (OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw f)
            OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw) ≤
        ↑(Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h)

headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSamplerCost.reserved_draw_work
headlines.statement:
∃ P,
  ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ℕ)
    (bits : Fin (Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h)) → Bool),
    have z := (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits);
    Math115.LatticeSampler.drawRealizer.cost z + OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSampler.draw z) ≤
      Polynomial.eval (Math115.CompletionEncodingSize.measure (List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c) h) P

headlines.name: Math115.LatticeSamplerCost.reserved_draw_work_literal
headlines.statement:
∃ P,
  ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (h : ℕ)
    (bits : Fin (Math115.LatticeScheduleProgram.totalBits ((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h)) → Bool),
    have z := (((List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c), h), List.ofFn bits);
    Math115.LatticeSampler.drawRealizer.cost z + OAI.MatchingFPRAS.TreeTyped.weight (Math115.LatticeSampler.draw z) ≤
      Polynomial.eval ((OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeMargins r c).length + h + 3) P

headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime_public_bound
headlines.statement:
∃ Ctime Dtime,
  0 < Ctime ∧
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ),
      ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j →
        ∀ (h : ℕ),
          1 ≤ h →
            Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) ≤
              Ctime * OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.samplingSize n r h ^ Dtime

headlines.name: Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machine_mass
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (htotal : ∑ i, r i = ∑ j, c j) (h t : ℕ),
  Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machineTime (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) ≤ t →
    ∀ (X : OAI.ContingencyTables.Table r c),
      OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.tableMass Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.machine
          (OAI.ContingencyTables.Algorithms.encodeSamplingInput r c h) t ↑X =
        ↑((OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.mapLaw OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw
                (Math115.PublicLatticeSampler.tableDraw r c htotal h)).mass
            X)
